accuracy.reason: Cards 1-4 correctly distinguish browser/shared response caches, layer-specific freshness with existing Age, conditional 304 body reuse and storage/privacy directives. Cards 5-8 preserve variant keys, purge reach, bounded stale reuse and measured request-ratio limits without universal freshness, privacy or availability claims.

evidence.quote: Identify the cache layer before saying which work a hit avoids.

mechanisms.reason: Every card supplies actors and effects: miss/return storage paths, age subtraction, If-None-Match validation and 304/200 branches, explicit private exclusion, meaningful query/header matching, versioned reference updates, bounded stale windows and denominator-based origin calculations. Application work is not inferred from body transfer.

evidence.quote: Use the layer's lifetime and the response's existing age together.

coherence.reason: HTTP/GET prerequisites suffice; eight cards develop layers, freshness, validation, privacy, matching, update management, stale failure behavior and value. Inspected bidirectional cache path and conditional branches correctly label origin contact even for 304. Shared renderer/CSS inspected earlier, not runtime-tested.

evidence.quote: Body bandwidth saved is different from an origin request avoided.

decisions.reason: Policies match public reuse, browser-only private data and sensitive no-store cases. Mutable pages need tolerated delay; purge cannot revoke downloads; optional stale allowances require eligible existing copies and provider support. Low private/low-reuse workloads may omit shared caching after total-cost measurement.

evidence.quote: no-cache means validate; no-store means do not store; private excludes shared caches.

clarity.reason: Definitions cover representation, opaque validator, directives, variants and ratio when needed. Age 90 and stale ages 75/150/200 make arithmetic explicit; examples distinguish no-cache/no-store/private and request versus byte savings without excessive protocol detail.

evidence.quote: Keep distinctions that change content; remove only distinctions proven irrelevant.

It distinguishes fresh permission from unchanged origin, sends opaque v1 in If-None-Match, handles 304 retained body/metadata and 200 replacement conditionally, and preserves origin/application/database work.

Learner defines cookie and credential roles, authentication versus permission, selects no-cache/public validation, private/browser-only and no-store/sensitive policies with correct limits, rejects cookie/auth automatic isolation or universal bypass, and retains origin permission plus verified cross-user CDN exclusion.

Learner defines keys and variants, preserves format query and language matching, qualifies Vary on actual support, corrects or bypasses ignored query/header settings, removes tracking only after proving irrelevance, and denies permission from variant separation.

Learner versions immutable bytes and updates referring page while allowing cached v1 references, assigns mutable freshness policy, rejects database automatic invalidation, verifies purge URL/variant/layer/completion scope and denies browser eviction or instant delivered-content revocation.

Learner explains background versus eligible-error stale reuse, computes ages75 within90 and150 within180 but200 outside both, requires support/policy/existing copy, excludes private/no-store override, and retains urgent-removal/private correctness tradeoffs.

sourceChecks.claim: Live Cloudflare CDN introduction supports geographically near shared content caches; RFC9111 response-cache model supports policy-gated storage and private/shared layer distinction.

Live MDN Cache-Control confirms s-maxage overrides only shared caches and max-age accounting uses existing Age; RFC9111 confirms freshness/current-age reuse model. Arithmetic and retention qualifications are correct.
Live MDN ETag example sends stored If-None-Match and obtains bodyless304 on match. RFC9111 validation rules support updating metadata and retaining body, not avoided origin work.

Live RFC9111 explicitly distinguishes unqualified private, no-cache and no-store, Authorization shared-cache exceptions and Set-Cookie not inhibiting caching. Origin permission and delivered-copy limits are preserved.

Live Cloudflare key documentation confirms ignored-query collisions and include/exclude settings; RFC9111 requires nominated Vary header matching. Lesson explicitly verifies actual CDN support and preserves privacy policies.

Live Cloudflare purge reference distinguishes targeted removal/invalidation and says200 acknowledges receipt rather than proving eviction, requiring asset verification. Browser caches and delivered files lie outside that provider operation; versioned immutable URLs avoid overwrite reuse.

Live RFC5861 defines additional stale-while-revalidate interval after freshness and stale-if-error upper staleness bound on eligible errors. The examples compute windows correctly and require cache eligibility rather than guaranteed availability.

Live Cloudflare hit-ratio definition is hits divided by hits plus misses; lesson narrows layer/denominator and explicitly separates bytes and real background/application work. Cost and workload-fit choice is conditional.
